item.title: 하루 30분 운동해도 남는 '오래 앉기'의 위험 - 진일보 | 전남일보
item.description:
요약

  • 하루 30분 운동으로는 종일 앉아서 보낸 시간의 위험까지 지울 수 없다는 연구 결과가 잇따르고 있다.
  • 규칙적으로 운동하더라도 지나치게 오래 앉아 있으면 심혈관질환이나 암으로 사망할 위험이 높아질 수 있다는 것이다.
  • 아이민 리 하버드의대 교수는 하버드 가제트 인터뷰에서 "앉아 있는 시간이 길어질수록 심혈관질환과 조기 사망 위험이 높아지는 경향이 있다"며 "하루 7~9시간을 넘어서면 위험 증가세가 더욱 가팔라질 수 있다"고 말했다.

본문

하루 30분 운동으로는 종일 앉아서 보낸 시간의 위험까지 지울 수 없다는 연구 결과가 잇따르고 있다. 규칙적으로 운동하더라도 지나치게 오래 앉아 있으면 심혈관질환이나 암으로 사망할 위험이 높아질 수 있다는 것이다.

아이민 리 하버드의대 교수는 하버드 가제트 인터뷰에서 "앉아 있는 시간이 길어질수록 심혈관질환과 조기 사망 위험이 높아지는 경향이 있다"며 "하루 7~9시간을 넘어서면 위험 증가세가 더욱 가팔라질 수 있다"고 말했다.

좌식 10.6시간 넘으면 심부전 위험 40%↑

2024년 11월 미국심장학회지(JACC)에 실린 하버드의대·브리검여성병원 연구팀 논문은 영국 바이오뱅크 성인 8만9530명을 분석했다. 참가자가 손목형 활동량 측정기를 일주일 착용한 뒤 약 8년간 건강 자료를 추적한 결과, 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘는 사람은 심부전 위험이 40%, 심혈관질환 사망 위험이 54% 높았다.

주 150분 이상 중강도 이상 운동을 하는 사람에게서도 이 연관성은 남았다. 다만 운동이 소용없다는 뜻은 아니다. 충분히 움직인 사람은 심방세동·심근경색 위험과의 연관성이 뚜렷하지 않았고, 심부전·심혈관질환 사망 위험의 증가 폭도 줄었다. 연구팀은 운동이 좌식 생활의 위험을 상당 부분 줄이지만 일부 위험까지 완전히 상쇄하지는 못할 수 있다고 해석했다.

앉기를 끊는 짧은 움직임이 열쇠

올해 7월 국제학술지 플로스 메디신(PLOS Medicine)에 발표된 연구는 영국 바이오뱅크 참가자 9만1292명을 중앙값 12.38년 추적했다.

영국 글래스고대가 이끌고 하버드대 연구진이 참여한 이 연구는 하루 총 앉은 시간만 따지지 않고 30분 이상 이어진 앉기와 중간중간 움직이며 앉은 시간을 구분했다. 장시간 연속해 앉아 있는 시간이 1시간 늘 때마다 암 사망 위험은 9% 높아졌다.

그 시간 중 하루 1시간을 가벼운 신체활동으로 바꾸면 12%, 하루 30분을 중강도 활동으로 바꿔도 8% 낮았다.

세계보건기구(WHO)는 성인에게 주 150~300분의 중강도 유산소 활동과 주 2회 이상 근력운동을 권고하면서 앉아 있는 시간도 줄이라고 한다.

아직 최적의 좌식 중단 간격이 확립된 것은 아니지만 30~60분마다 잠시 일어나 복도를 걷거나 통화를 서서 하는 습관은 생활 속 목표로 삼을 만하다. 리 교수는 "규칙적인 유산소운동과 근력운동에 더해 앉아 있는 시간을 줄이는 노력이 함께 이뤄져야 한다"고 강조했다.

출처: 진일보 | 전남일보

item.title: Cardiac Awareness and Education Linked to Earlier Emergency Arrival in Egyptian Heart Attack Study - Bioengineer.org
item.description:
요약

  • ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction represents the most severe manifestation of acute coronary syndrome, typically resulting from complete thrombotic occlusion of an epicardial coronary artery that deprives myocardial tissue of vital perfusion.
  • Overall, baseline cardiac health awareness was documented in only 51 patients, meaning that just 31 percent of the admitted cohort possessed prior understanding of coronary warning signs and appropriate emergency responses.
  • Interestingly, the researchers noted that while educational status and health awareness both independently facilitated earlier emergency arrival, formal education did not directly correlate with health awareness itself within the cohort.

본문

Patients experiencing acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction arrived at the emergency department significantly earlier when they possessed prior cardiac health awareness or higher formal educational attainment, according to an observational cohort study conducted at the National Heart Institute in Egypt. The clinical investigation, published in the Journal of the Egyptian Public Health Association, examined presentation timelines among individuals admitted for primary percutaneous coronary intervention to determine how personal knowledge and social factors influence the critical window between symptom onset and hospital arrival. Across the evaluated clinical cohort, the researchers observed that prior exposure to heart disease information and completion of advanced schooling were each independently correlated with expedited hospital presentation, even as the cohort as a whole exhibited profound prehospital treatment delays.

ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction represents the most severe manifestation of acute coronary syndrome, typically resulting from complete thrombotic occlusion of an epicardial coronary artery that deprives myocardial tissue of vital perfusion. Clinical management protocols dictate that coronary revascularization should ideally be accomplished within ninety minutes of initial medical contact using catheter-based intervention to mechanically restore vascular patency. While structured emergency triage pathways and dedicated cardiac response systems have substantially reduced in-hospital door-to-balloon intervals, clinical outcomes remain tightly bound to total ischemic duration, which encompasses the critical prehospital delay from initial symptom onset to hospital arrival. Prolonged ischemic intervals subject the myocardium to irreversible ischemic injury, substantially increasing the risk of adverse clinical endpoints, including microvascular obstruction, catastrophic heart failure, ventricular arrhythmias, and in-hospital mortality.

To evaluate the specific drivers of prehospital transit times, the investigators established a prospective observational cohort at Egypt’s National Heart Institute, identified as the nation’s highest-volume primary percutaneous coronary intervention center handling an average of fifteen emergency revascularization procedures daily. Over a designated six-month recruitment period spanning March to September 2023, clinical teams gathered demographic data, medical histories, and precise chronological milestones from consecutive patients presenting to the emergency room with confirmed acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. The analytic protocol focused exclusively on patients aged eighteen to seventy-five years who presented within forty-eight hours of symptom onset and proceeded to the catheterization laboratory for emergency revascularization, compiling comprehensive records across the initial emergency intake, percutaneous intervention, and inpatient hospital admission.

item.title: 하루 좌식 10.6시간 넘으면…심부전 위험 40% 증가 : 건강 - 재경일보
item.description:
요약

  • 하루 10.6시간을 초과해 앉아서 생활하면 심부전 발생 위험이 40% 높아진다는 연구 결과가 나왔다.
  • 규칙적인 운동을 하더라도 깨어 있는 동안 장시간 앉아 있는 좌식 생활을 지속하면 심혈관질환과 암으로 인한 사망 위험이 커지는 것으로 조사됐다.
  • 분석 결과 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘는 사람은 10.6시간 이하인 사람보다 심부전 발생 위험이 40%, 심혈관질환 사망 위험이 54% 높았다.

본문

하루 10.6시간을 초과해 앉아서 생활하면 심부전 발생 위험이 40% 높아진다는 연구 결과가 나왔다.

아침 식탁에서 시작된 좌식 생활은 출근길 자동차와 사무실 책상으로 이어지며, 퇴근 후에도 소파에 앉아 TV를 보거나 스마트폰을 들여다보는 시간이 적지 않다. 이렇게 하루 대부분을 앉아서 보내더라도 저녁에 30분 정도 걷거나 헬스장에서 운동하면 건강에 문제가 없을지에 대해 의학계에서는 경고의 목소리가 커지고 있다.

규칙적인 운동을 하더라도 깨어 있는 동안 장시간 앉아 있는 좌식 생활을 지속하면 심혈관질환과 암으로 인한 사망 위험이 커지는 것으로 조사됐다.

미국 하버드대 공식 매체 하버드 가제트에 따르면 하버드의대 아이민 리 교수는 인터뷰에서 앉아 있는 시간이 길어질수록 심혈관질환과 조기 사망 위험이 높아지는 경향이 있으며 하루 7∼9시간을 넘어서면 위험 증가세가 더욱 가팔라질 수 있다고 밝혔다. 좌식 생활은 단순히 운동을 하지 않는 운동 부족과 구별되는 개념이다.

운동 부족이 신체활동의 양에 관한 문제라면 좌식 생활은 깨어 있는 동안 앉거나 기대거나 누운 자세로 에너지 소비가 적은 상태를 오래 유지하는 것을 뜻한다. 전문가들은 하루 30분 운동하더라도 나머지 시간을 대부분 앉아서 보낼 경우 좌식 생활의 위험을 모두 없애기는 어렵다고 지적한다.

좌식 10.6시간 넘으면 심혈관 사망률 54% 상승

장시간 좌식 생활과 심혈관질환 발생 사이의 연관성은 대규모 코호트 분석에서 확인됐다. 지난해 미국심장학회지(JACC)에 발표된 연구에서 하버드 의대와 브리검여성병원 연구팀은 영국 바이오뱅크에 참여한 성인 8만9530명의 활동량과 질환 발생 위험을 추적했다.

연구팀은 참가자들에게 손목형 활동량 측정기를 일주일 동안 착용하게 해 하루 중 앉아서 보내는 시간과 신체 활동량을 측정한 뒤 약 8년 동안의 건강자료를 추적해 심방세동, 심근경색, 심부전, 심혈관질환 사망 기록을 관찰했다. 분석 결과 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘는 사람은 10.6시간 이하인 사람보다 심부전 발생 위험이 40%, 심혈관질환 사망 위험이 54% 높았다. 특히 심부전과 심혈관질환 사망 위험은 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘어서면서 증가세가 두드러졌다.

일주일에 150분 이상 중강도 또는 고강도 운동을 실천하는 사람에게서도 장시간 좌식 생활과 심혈관질환 사망 위험 사이의 연관성은 완전히 사라지지 않았다. 운동을 충분히 한 집단은 장시간 좌식 생활과 심방세동·심근경색 위험 사이의 연관성이 뚜렷하지 않았고 심부전과 심혈관질환 사망 위험의 증가 폭도 줄었으나 위험이 완전히 상쇄되지는 않았다.

연구팀은 운동이 장시간 좌식 생활의 위험을 상당 부분 줄여주지만, 일부 심혈관질환 위험까지 완전히 상쇄하지는 못할 수 있다고 해석했다.

연속 좌식 1시간 늘 때마다 암 사망 위험 9% 커져

좌식 생활은 심장에만 국한되지 않고 암 사망 위험과도 밀접하게 연관된 것으로 나타났다. 올해 7월 국제학술지 플로스 메디신(PLOS Medicine)에 실린 연구에서 하버드대 보건대학원과 영국 글래스고대 등이 참여한 국제 공동연구팀은 영국 바이오뱅크 참가자 9만1292명의 활동량 측정 데이터를 중앙값 12.38년 동안 추적해 암 발생과 사망 여부를 살폈다.

이 연구의 특징은 단순히 하루 총 좌식 시간을 따진 것 외에도, 장시간 연속해서 앉아 있는 경우와 중간중간 움직이면서 앉아 있는 시간을 나눠 보낸 경우를 구분해 분석했다는 점이다. 그 결과 장시간 연속해서 앉아 있는 시간이 하루 중 1시간 늘어날 때마다 암 사망 위험은 9% 증가했다.

반면 장시간 앉아 있는 시간 중 하루 1시간을 가벼운 신체활동으로 대체하면 암 사망 위험이 12% 낮아졌고 하루 30분을 중강도 활동으로 대체했을 때도 위험이 8% 감소했다.

연구팀은 하버드 가제트 인터뷰를 통해 사무실을 가볍게 걷거나 집안일을 하는 수준의 활동도 암 사망 위험을 낮추는 데 기여할 수 있다고 설명했다. 이는 단순히 총 좌식 시간을 줄이는 것 외에도 앉아 있는 시간을 쪼개 신체활동으로 전환하는 방식이 유효함을 보여준다.

근육 활동 저하가 혈관 기능 악화 유발

장시간 앉아 있는 자세가 만성질환을 유발하는 주요 기전으로는 근육 활동량 감소가 꼽힌다. 오래 움직이지 않으면 다리 근육의 기능이 저하돼 혈액순환과 혈관 기능에 이상이 발생할 수 있다.

근육이 혈액 속 포도당을 사용하는 활동이 줄어들면서 혈당 조절 기능과 인슐린 작용에도 장애가 생길 가능성이 높아진다. 이러한 생리적 변화가 누적되면 비만, 당뇨병, 심혈관질환 등 만성질환 발병 가능성을 높이는 요인으로 작용한다.

세계보건기구(WHO)는 성인 기준 일주일 150∼300분의 중강도 유산소 신체활동이나 75∼150분의 고강도 유산소 신체활동, 주 2회 이상의 근력운동을 권장하고 있다. 아울러 좌식 시간을 줄이고 해당 시간을 가벼운 신체활동으로 대체할 것을 요구한다. 건강을 위해 운동하는 것과 별개로 일상에서 앉아 있는 시간을 줄이는 노력이 필요하다는 취지다.

전문가들은 사무실에서 일정 시간마다 자리에서 일어나 복도를 걷거나 서서 통화하고, 점심 식사 후 산책이나 계단 이용을 통해 좌식 시간을 줄일 수 있다고 조언한다. 집에서도 TV를 보다가 중간에 일어나 움직이거나 짧게 산책하는 방식으로 앉아 있는 시간을 줄일 수 있다.

최적의 좌식 중단 주기가 명확히 확립되지는 않았으나 일상에서 30∼60분 간격으로 일어나 몸을 움직이는 습관을 권장한다. 아이민 리 교수는 규칙적인 유산소운동과 근력운동에 더해 앉아 있는 시간을 줄이는 노력이 함께 이뤄져야 한다고 밝혔다.

출처: 재경일보

item.title: 운동했으니 괜찮다? 오래 앉으면 심장·암 위험 커진다 : 사회 - 재경일보
item.description:
요약

  • 하루 30분 운동을 하더라도 나머지 시간을 대부분 앉아서 보내면 심혈관질환과 암으로 사망할 위험이 커질 수 있다는 연구 결과가 잇따르고 있다.
  • 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘은 사람은 그 이하인 사람보다 심부전 발생 위험이 40%, 심혈관질환 사망 위험이 54% 높았다.
  • 충분히 운동한 사람에게서는 좌식 시간과 심방세동·심근경색 위험의 연관성이 뚜렷하지 않았고, 심부전과 심혈관질환 사망 위험의 증가 폭도 줄었다.

본문

하루 30분 운동을 하더라도 나머지 시간을 대부분 앉아서 보내면 심혈관질환과 암으로 사망할 위험이 커질 수 있다는 연구 결과가 잇따르고 있다. 특히 오래 끊기지 않고 앉아 있는 시간을 가벼운 움직임으로 바꾸는 생활 습관이 중요하다는 분석이다.

운동해도 사라지지 않는 좌식생활 위험

좌식생활은 단순히 운동을 하지 않는 상태와 다르다. 깨어 있는 동안 앉거나 기대거나 누워 에너지 소비가 적은 자세를 오래 유지하는 것을 뜻한다. 아침 식사부터 출퇴근길 자동차, 사무실 책상과 퇴근 뒤 소파까지 앉아 있는 시간은 하루 곳곳에 자리 잡고 있다. 저녁에 걷기나 헬스장 운동을 하더라도 깨어 있는 동안 장시간 앉아 지내는 습관의 위험이 모두 없어지는 것은 아니다. 하버드대 아이민 리 교수는 앉아 있는 시간이 길수록 심혈관질환과 조기 사망 위험이 높아지는 경향이 있으며, 하루 7∼9시간을 넘기면 위험 증가세가 더 가팔라질 수 있다고 설명했다.

10.6시간 넘으면 심부전 위험 40% 증가

하버드 의대와 매사추세츠종합병원·브리검여성병원 연구진은 영국 바이오뱅크 성인 8만9천530명의 손목형 활동량계 자료를 분석했다. 참가자들의 활동량을 일주일 동안 측정한 뒤 약 8년간 건강자료를 추적해 좌식 시간과 심방세동, 심근경색, 심부전, 심혈관질환 사망의 연관성을 살폈다. 하루 좌식 시간이 10.6시간을 넘은 사람은 그 이하인 사람보다 심부전 발생 위험이 40%, 심혈관질환 사망 위험이 54% 높았다. 위험은 특히 10.6시간을 넘어서면서 두드러졌다. 일주일에 150분 이상 중강도 또는 고강도 운동을 한 사람도 장시간 앉아 있는 습관과 심혈관질환 사망 위험의 연관성이 일부 남았다. 운동이 무의미하다는 뜻은 아니다. 충분히 운동한 사람에게서는 좌식 시간과 심방세동·심근경색 위험의 연관성이 뚜렷하지 않았고, 심부전과 심혈관질환 사망 위험의 증가 폭도 줄었다. 연구진은 운동이 좌식생활의 위험을 상당 부분 낮추지만, 일부 위험까지 모두 없애지는 못할 수 있다고 봤다.

item.title: Add-on test to help classify pulmonary hypertension types now available in US - Pulmonary Hypertension News
item.description:
요약

  • Add-on test to help classify pulmonary hypertension types now available in US
  • A noninvasive test that can help clinicians distinguish between different types of pulmonary hypertension (PH) is now commercially available in the U.S.
  • “Adding PCWP means more patients with suspected heart failure … can be identified earlier and routed to the appropriate care pathway,” said Charles R. Bridges, MD, executive vice president and chief scientific officer at Corvista.

본문

Add-on test to help classify pulmonary hypertension types now available in US

Distinguishing heart-related PH can guide proper treatment plans

A noninvasive test that can help clinicians distinguish between different types of pulmonary hypertension (PH) is now commercially available in the U.S.

The test, dubbed the CorVista System Pulmonary Capillary Wedge Pressure (PCWP) Add-On, is an AI-powered add-on tool that can be used to help interpret signals from a point-of-care test that is offered by Corvista Health and Analytics 4 Life. The same system is already in use to help detect PH and other cardiovascular issues. The new add-on feature was cleared by U.S. regulators over the summer, and Corvista announced in a press release that the feature is now commercially available.

PCWP, the score measured by the new add-on test, is basically an estimate of the amount of pressure in the left atrium, the part of the heart that receives oxygen-rich blood from the lungs. High PCWP is a strong indicator of heart failure — meaning the heart is not effectively pumping blood throughout the body.

Different types of PH requires different treatments

PH refers to higher-than-normal pressure in the vessels that carry oxygen-depleted blood from the heart to the lungs. In PH associated with left-sided heart disease, one of the forms of PH, this pressure becomes elevated as a consequence of heart failure — essentially, the heart isn’t pumping out blood well, and blood becomes backed up in the lungs’ vessels as a consequence. But other forms of PH are unrelated to heart failure. For example, pulmonary arterial hypertension is driven by the abnormal growth of cells that line vessels in the lungs, causing these vessels to narrow.

Adding PCWP means more patients with suspected heart failure … can be identified earlier and routed to the appropriate care pathway.

Distinguishing between types of PH that are or are not associated with heart failure is crucial, because each of these different types of PH requires different treatments for effective management.

“Adding PCWP means more patients with suspected heart failure … can be identified earlier and routed to the appropriate care pathway,” said Charles R. Bridges, MD, executive vice president and chief scientific officer at Corvista.

Alongside the commercial launch of this add-on, Corvista also launched a Clinical Decision Support program, which aims to offer clinicians guideline-backed assistance in interpreting and implementing test results, taking into account factors like patients’ demographic background and symptoms.

“By combining established guideline-grounded recommendations with Corvista’s validated diagnostic performance, we give physicians a patient-specific probability of disease and a clear path forward,” Bridges said.

item.title: Cyanotic Congenital Heart Disease Linked to Higher Neonatal Mortality in Mexican Study - Bioengineer.org
item.description:
요약

  • A decade-long hospital-based study in northeastern Mexico has evaluated the clinical characteristics, management, and survival outcomes of neonates admitted to a tertiary intensive care unit with echocardiographically confirmed congenital heart disease.
  • Congenital heart defects represent the most common congenital malformations worldwide and remain a major contributor to neonatal morbidity and mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income regions where specialized care is limited.
  • Article Title: Epidemiology, clinical characteristics, surgical management and outcomes of neonates with congenital heart disease in a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit: a 10-year

본문

A decade-long hospital-based study in northeastern Mexico has evaluated the clinical characteristics, management, and survival outcomes of neonates admitted to a tertiary intensive care unit with echocardiographically confirmed congenital heart disease. Congenital heart defects represent the most common congenital malformations worldwide and remain a major contributor to neonatal morbidity and mortality, particularly in low- and middle-income regions where specialized care is limited. Analyzing ten consecutive years of admissions, researchers determined that neonates with cyanotic defects experienced significantly higher in-hospital mortality compared with those exhibiting acyanotic lesions. The findings, published in the Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery, also identified surgical procedures requiring cardiopulmonary bypass support and prolonged aortic cross-clamp duration as key factors strongly associated with mortality within the regional referral center.

The investigation was conducted as a single-center, hospital-based retrospective cohort study encompassing all neonates with echocardiographically confirmed congenital heart disease admitted to the tertiary neonatal intensive care unit of the Hospital Regional de Alta Especialidad de Ciudad Victoria between January 2015 and December 2024. Across this ten-year window, 802 neonates were admitted to the intensive care facility, of whom 111 had confirmed congenital heart defects. This case volume corresponded to a hospital-based prevalence of 13.8 percent among all nursery admissions during the decade. The researchers noted that this estimate reflects institutional frequency within a tertiary referral unit and must not be interpreted as a population-based prevalence rate for the general newborn population.

Diagnostic frequency shifted when clinical parameters were refined to exclude cases of isolated patent ductus arteriosus directly associated with prematurity. After excluding those isolated prematurity-associated cases, the recorded hospital-based prevalence of structural congenital heart disease decreased to 9.1 percent. Descriptive analyses indicated that the confirmed patient cohort had a mean gestational age of 34.8 weeks, with a standard deviation of 4.5 weeks, and a mean birth weight of 2295 grams, with a standard deviation of 1083 grams. In addition, premature infants comprised a major portion of the study population, with preterm neonates accounting for 58.6 percent of all diagnosed cases managed within the intensive care unit.

item.title: Maintain a regular sleep schedule to show love to this vital organ, researchers say - Safety+Health Magazine
item.description:
요약

  • A regular sleep schedule may help you avoid more than fatigue.
  • Researchers looked at sleep data from more than 10,000 adults who wore an activity tracking device as part of the National Institutes of Health’s “All of Us” Research Program.
  • - An irregular sleep schedule over a six-month period was linked to a 20%-23% higher risk of “serious heart events.”

본문

A regular sleep schedule may help you avoid more than fatigue. It may also help stave off a heart attack or other cardiovascular issues, according to a recent study.

Researchers looked at sleep data from more than 10,000 adults who wore an activity tracking device as part of the National Institutes of Health’s “All of Us” Research Program.

Here’s what they found:

- An irregular sleep schedule over a six-month period was linked to a 20%-23% higher risk of “serious heart events.” They include heart attack, stroke and heart failure.

- Each 29-minute increase in how much participants’ sleep length varied from night to night was associated with a 24% higher risk of the “combined cardiovascular outcome,” including a 29% higher risk of having a heart muscle disease, which leaves the heart unable to pump enough blood through the body, and a 20% higher risk of heart failure.

- Having a greater number of “complete sleep cycles” each night was associated with a 28% lower risk of atrial arrhythmia, a common type of irregular heartbeat.

“Sleep irregularity is often due to weekends – we get to sleep a little bit later on a Friday night; or people have shift work,” lead researcher Nguyen Minh Tuan, a neuroscientist and postdoctoral research fellow at Boston Children’s Hospital and Harvard Medical School. “This may not be good for your heart health.

“Sometimes the quality of sleep is something we can’t control. But the regularity, consistent bedtimes throughout the week and waking up at the same time every morning, is something some people can control.”

The researchers presented their findings in November at the American Heart Association’s Scientific Sessions 2026.

item.title: Heart Stents May Not Prevent Heart Attacks or Early Death, Landmark Study Finds - SciTechDaily
item.description:
요약

  • A stent can restore blood flow to the heart, but in people with stable coronary disease, it may offer no added protection against heart attacks or early death.
  • For someone told they have a narrowed heart artery, opening it can seem like the obvious next step.
  • They found no statistically significant difference in the combined risk of death or heart attack between patients initially assigned to an artery-opening procedure plus medical therapy and those assigned to medical therapy alone.

본문

A stent can restore blood flow to the heart, but in people with stable coronary disease, it may offer no added protection against heart attacks or early death.

For someone told they have a narrowed heart artery, opening it can seem like the obvious next step. Yet improving blood flow and preventing future health problems are separate goals, and a procedure that achieves one may not necessarily achieve the other.

Researchers led by Neel Butala, MD, of the University of Colorado Anschutz, examined that question through an extended follow-up of participants in the COURAGE trial. They found no statistically significant difference in the combined risk of death or heart attack between patients initially assigned to an artery-opening procedure plus medical therapy and those assigned to medical therapy alone.

Published in JAMA and presented at the 2026 American Heart Association Scientific Sessions, the findings offer an unusually long look at how these treatment strategies compare.

What The Long-Term Stent Study Found

The original COURAGE trial enrolled people with stable coronary artery disease and compared optimal medical therapy alone with optimal medical therapy plus percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), commonly known as angioplasty.

During angioplasty, doctors inflate a small balloon inside a narrowed artery to improve blood flow. They often place a tiny metal tube called a stent to help keep the artery open.

For the new analysis, researchers tracked 959 participants through linked health records. The median follow-up was 15 years, with some patients followed for as long as 25 years. The estimated 25-year cumulative incidence of death or heart attack was 93.3% in the group initially assigned to PCI plus medical therapy and 91% in the medical therapy group. That difference was not statistically significant.

Earlier research had examined long-term survival after the trial. This analysis also included heart attacks, allowing researchers to assess whether an initial PCI strategy might prevent cardiovascular events that would not be captured by survival figures alone.

Better Blood Flow Does Not Guarantee Longer Life

The central finding concerns what happens after an artery has been successfully opened. Restoring blood flow can relieve symptoms, but the study did not find evidence that starting with PCI lowered the combined long-term risk of heart attack or death.

“When we open a blocked artery, we know we’ve improved blood flow through that artery, and that relieves symptoms. But the bigger question is whether that translates into a reduction in clinical events such as heart attacks or death for patients over the long term. That’s what we wanted to understand with this study,” said Butala, an assistant professor of medicine-cardiology at the CU Anschutz School of Medicine.

item.title: SUMMIT Substudy Reveals Tirzepatide’s Impact on LV, Atrial Metrics of HFpEF - HCPLive
item.description:
요약

  • SUMMIT Substudy Reveals Tirzepatide’s Impact on LV, Atrial Metrics of HFpEF
  • Tirzepatide treatment effectively reduced multiple ventricular and atrial measures of heart function in patients with obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), based on a cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging substudy of the SUMMIT trial.1
  • SUMMIT was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 study evaluating the efficacy and safety of tirzepatide compared to placebo in patients with HFpEF and obesity.

본문

SUMMIT Substudy Reveals Tirzepatide’s Impact on LV, Atrial Metrics of HFpEF

Christopher Kramer, MD, discusses his substudy of SUMMIT, which utilized CMR imaging to evaluate further heart health metrics versus standard imaging.

Tirzepatide treatment effectively reduced multiple ventricular and atrial measures of heart function in patients with obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), based on a cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging substudy of the SUMMIT trial.1

This substudy was presented at the American Heart Association (AHA) Scientific Sessions 2026 in Chicago, Illinois, by Christopher Kramer, MD, chief of the cardiovascular division and George A. Beller Distinguished Professor of Cardiovascular Medicine at the University of Virginia Health System.1

“Most studies previously with HFpEF therapies have been with echo, and echo is less sensitive for assessment of the right ventricle, left atrium, and right atrium,” Kramer told HCPLive in an exclusive interview. “Because CMR is a very accurate imaging modality for LV, RV, and atrial size and function, we can make important observations in many fewer patients.”

The History of SUMMIT

SUMMIT was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 study evaluating the efficacy and safety of tirzepatide compared to placebo in patients with HFpEF and obesity. Patients were eligible for inclusion if they had a diagnosis of stable HF of New York Heart Association class II-IV and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥50%. Additionally, patients were required to have elevated NT-proBNP and a body mass index (BMI) ≥30 kg/m2.2

Patients enrolled in the study would receive either a starting dose of tirzepatide 2.5 mg administered once weekly, followed by escalation by 2.5 mg every 4 weeks to a maximum of 15 mg, or matching placebo. The primary endpoints were change from baseline in the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) Clinical Summary Score (CSS) by week 52 and first occurrence of a composite of cardiovascular death or death from a worsening HF event.2

A total of 364 patients were enrolled in the tirzepatide group, and 367 were assigned to receive placebo. The median duration of follow-up was 104 weeks – during this time, the composite mortality endpoint occurred in 36 patients receiving tirzepatide and 56 receiving placebo (HR, 0.62; 95% CI, 0.41 to 0.95; P = .026). At week 52, mean change in KCCQ-CSS was 19.5 +/- 1.2 in the tirzepatide group and 12.7 +/- 1.3 in the placebo group (between-group difference, 6.9; 95% CI, 3.3 to 10.6; P <.001).3

item.title: Heart rhythm data reveal early signs of heart disease before conventional measures - Medical Xpress
item.description:
요약

  • Heart rhythm data reveal early signs of heart disease before conventional measures
  • The heart does not beat like a regular clock.
  • Researchers at Tampere and Stanford universities have shown that the patterns of these subtle variations can reveal the early effects of cardiomyopathy, which is a hereditary heart disease.

본문

Heart rhythm data reveal early signs of heart disease before conventional measures

Scientific Editor

The heart does not beat like a regular clock. Even at rest, the time between successive heartbeats continuously varies. Researchers at Tampere and Stanford universities have shown that the patterns of these subtle variations can reveal the early effects of cardiomyopathy, which is a hereditary heart disease. The paper is published in the journal Circulation: Arrhythmia and Electrophysiology.

Heart function is commonly assessed by measuring heart rate and heart rate variability. Heart rate variability describes the variation between the intervals of successive heartbeats. However, conventional measures, such as ECG, do not fully capture how this variation is organized over time.

In their recently published study, researchers from Tampere and Stanford universities analyzed these variations in great detail across different timescales. The study combined experimental cardiac electrophysiology in an LMNA mouse model with advanced time-series analysis methods developed in physics. The methods enabled the detection of signs of heart disease at a very early stage.

LMNA is a gene that encodes proteins that form the structural framework of the cell nucleus. Mutations in this gene can cause cardiomyopathy, a disease of the heart muscle that may lead to abnormal heart rhythm, heart failure or sudden cardiac death. In the study, mice were engineered to carry an LMNA mutation that mimics the effects of cardiomyopathy in the heart.

The researchers analyzed short electrocardiogram, or ECG, recordings from mice. Some of the mice did not carry the LMNA mutation, some had one mutated copy of the gene, and some had two. Conventional heart rate variability measures did not clearly distinguish the groups, which is why the researchers examined temporal heartbeat patterns across several timescales, ranging from a few successive beats to longer sequences.

"What matters in particular is how the changes between heartbeats are organized over time. The heart continuously adapts to the body's changing needs, and this adaptability may provide information about the condition it is in," explains Esa Räsänen, Tampere University professor and the corresponding author of the study.

The outcomes on mice with one mutated copy were especially interesting. These mice do not usually develop a clear impairment of heart function or die prematurely. However, their heartbeat dynamics already differed from those of mice that did not have the mutation.

"The finding suggests that the mutation may affect the regulation of heart rhythm before conventional signs of heart disease become apparent," says postdoctoral researcher Hiroyuki Inoue from Stanford University.

item.title: Quadruple Therapy for Heart Failure Reached 14.5 Percent in Singapore - Bioengineer.org
item.description:
요약

  • Prescriptions for guideline-recommended quadruple therapy among patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction rose from zero in 2017 to 14.5 percent in 2022 across five tertiary care hospitals in Singapore, according to a cross-sectional study.
  • International clinical guidelines from the American Heart Association in 2022 and the European Society of Cardiology in 2021 recommend combining four distinct medication classes to manage the condition.
  • Subject of Research: Guideline adherence and real-world prescription patterns for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

본문

Prescriptions for guideline-recommended quadruple therapy among patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction rose from zero in 2017 to 14.5 percent in 2022 across five tertiary care hospitals in Singapore, according to a cross-sectional study. International clinical guidelines from the American Heart Association in 2022 and the European Society of Cardiology in 2021 recommend combining four distinct medication classes to manage the condition. Despite those explicit recommendations, the observational findings show that overall adoption of the comprehensive four-drug regimen remained substantially below expected guideline benchmarks.

The recommended quadruple regimen consists of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors, beta-blockers, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, and a choice of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, angiotensin II receptor blockers, or angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. To evaluate real-world clinical practices over time, investigators extracted administrative healthcare records spanning 2017 through 2022 from the Singapore Cardiovascular Longitudinal Outcomes Database. The descriptive analysis focused on evaluating overall drug combination choices, tracking longitudinal prescription trends, and measuring dosage adherence against guideline-directed targets.

The study cohort comprised 6,578 patients diagnosed with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Within this patient group, the median age was 71 years, 70.2 percent of the individuals were male, and 62.6 percent were identified as Chinese. Clinical measurements recorded across the cohort demonstrated a mean left ventricular ejection fraction of 28 percent.

Prescription patterns documented in 2022 revealed that 23.8 percent of patients received triple therapy. The most common three-drug combination paired a beta-blocker and a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist with either an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor, an angiotensin II receptor blocker, or an angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitor. Dual therapy accounted for 23.7 percent of the cohort, most commonly uniting a beta-blocker with one of the three renin-angiotensin system inhibitors.

Monotherapy was documented in 25.9 percent of the patients in 2022, while 12.1 percent received none of the recommended drug classes. When assessing dosing patterns, researchers found that approximately 80 percent of patients prescribed renin-angiotensin system inhibitors and 60 percent prescribed beta-blockers received less than half of guideline-recommended target doses. In contrast, 95 percent of patients taking sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors reached the recommended fixed target dosage.

item.title: In Vitro Models Map Cytoskeletal Failure in Rare Desmin-Related Cardiomyopathies - Bioengineer.org
item.description:
요약

  • Desmin-related cardiomyopathy represents a severe group of genetic cardiac conditions caused by pathogenic variants in the DES gene, which encodes the primary intermediate filament protein of striated muscle tissue.
  • Pathogenic mutations disrupt these steps, causing defective filament assembly, impaired network integration, and toxic protein aggregation that compromise cellular architecture and lead to progressive heart failure, cardiac conduction disease, and severe ventricular arrhythmias.
  • Using fluorescence resonance energy transfer in HL-1 cells, investigators tracked variants including p.S13F, p.E114del, p.N116S, p.N342D, and p.R454W, showing that mutant desmin can either co-exist with wild-type protein or disrupt the network depending on the mutation.

본문

Desmin-related cardiomyopathy represents a severe group of genetic cardiac conditions caused by pathogenic variants in the DES gene, which encodes the primary intermediate filament protein of striated muscle tissue. In healthy cardiac muscle, desmin monomers assemble through a tightly coordinated hierarchical sequence, progressing from coiled-coil dimers into antiparallel tetramers, which then associate into unit-length filaments before undergoing longitudinal annealing and radial compaction into mature filaments. This extensive intermediate filament network extends from the plasma membrane to the nuclear envelope, mechanically anchoring the contractile apparatus of the sarcomere to the sarcolemma, the extracellular matrix, and neighboring cells at costameres, intercalated discs, and Z-discs. Pathogenic mutations disrupt these steps, causing defective filament assembly, impaired network integration, and toxic protein aggregation that compromise cellular architecture and lead to progressive heart failure, cardiac conduction disease, and severe ventricular arrhythmias.

Because clinical desminopathies are exceptionally rare conditions with an estimated prevalence of fewer than five individuals per ten thousand, investigating disease mechanisms directly within patient heart tissue presents substantial logistical obstacles. Clinical manifestations span dilated, arrhythmogenic, and restrictive cardiomyopathy phenotypes, and the specific molecular determinants driving these divergent outcomes have remained incompletely understood. To delineate how individual mutations compromise cardiac architecture, investigators rely on a tiered spectrum of non-human and human in vitro experimental systems. A comprehensive review published in the Journal of Cellular and Molecular Medicine examines how researchers utilize these cellular models, spanning simplified non-contractile human lines, rodent myoblasts, immortalized atrial cardiomyocytes, primary rodent myocytes, and patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes, to uncover the precise biomechanical, proteostatic, and metabolic defects triggered by desmin mutations.

item.title: Lower Preoperative Sodium Linked to Acute Kidney Injury After Cardiac Surgery - Bioengineer.org
item.description:
요약

  • Analyzing data from adult individuals undergoing major cardiac procedures with elevated baseline risk scores, the study examined whether natremia levels, including those falling within conventional reference ranges, influence renal vulnerability.
  • Postoperative acute kidney injury represents a substantial complication within this clinical domain, affecting an estimated 20 to 40 percent of patients undergoing cardiac surgery.
  • Postoperative moderate-to-severe renal injury occurred in 38.0 percent of patients in the lowest natremia group of 139 millimoles per liter or less, compared with 25.8 percent in the intermediate group and 23.9 percent in the reference group above 141 millimoles per liter.

본문

A prospective multicenter cohort investigation conducted across fourteen cardiothoracic surgical centers in Spain and the United Kingdom indicates that lower preoperative serum sodium concentrations may be linked to an elevated risk of postoperative acute kidney injury among high-risk surgical candidates. Analyzing data from adult individuals undergoing major cardiac procedures with elevated baseline risk scores, the study examined whether natremia levels, including those falling within conventional reference ranges, influence renal vulnerability. When evaluated with adjustment for patient age and preoperative baseline creatinine, individuals presenting with preoperative serum sodium measurements of 139 millimoles per liter or less demonstrated an estimated twofold increase in the odds of experiencing moderate-to-severe postoperative acute kidney injury compared to individuals with sodium concentrations exceeding 141 millimoles per liter. However, investigators observed that this association was attenuated and lost formal statistical significance once statistical models incorporated a wider array of intraoperative and procedural risk factors.

The investigation addresses a critical perioperative challenge, as approximately 1.5 million cardiac surgical procedures are performed across the globe each year. Postoperative acute kidney injury represents a substantial complication within this clinical domain, affecting an estimated 20 to 40 percent of patients undergoing cardiac surgery. The development of renal injury following such operations is strongly correlated with increased morbidity, higher mortality rates, prolonged stays in intensive care units and hospital wards, and elevated overall healthcare expenditures. Even mild manifestations of postoperative renal impairment are documented to increase both short-term and long-term mortality risks. Furthermore, patients experiencing acute kidney injury face an elevated probability of progressing toward chronic kidney disease or requiring renal replacement therapy, an intervention associated with substantial mortality. Although dysnatremia is encountered in 15 to 30 percent of hospitalized patients, optimal preoperative sodium thresholds specifically relevant to major cardiac surgery have remained largely undefined.

  • 질병관리청 국가건강정보포털의 ‘심부전’ 자료에 따르면 갑작스러운 체중 증가는 몸에 수분과 소금이 머물러 있거나 심부전이 악화하고 있음을 의미할 수 있다.

본문

심부전 환자가 아침마다 체중을 기록하면 몸속 수분이 쌓이는 변화를 살피는 단서가 된다. 갑작스러운 체중 증가는 심부전 악화 신호일 수 있어, 체중 변화와 다른 증상을 함께 확인하는 것이 중요하다.)

질병관리청 국가건강정보포털의 ‘심부전’ 자료에 따르면 갑작스러운 체중 증가는 몸에 수분과 소금이 머물러 있거나 심부전이 악화하고 있음을 의미할 수 있다. 다만 체중 변화만으로 상태를 확정할 수는 없으며, 계속 체중이 늘면 의료진과 상의해야 한다.)

대한심부전학회의 ‘심부전 생활백서’는 가급적 매일 아침 식전에 체중을 재도록 안내한다. 서울아산병원 심부전 자가관리 자료는 기상 후 첫 소변을 본 뒤 아침 식사 전에, 매일 같은 시간과 같은 체중계로 측정하는 방법을 제시한다.

측정 조건이 달라지면 수치를 비교하기 어려울 수 있다. 체중을 잰 뒤 날짜와 숫자를 기록하고, 다음 진료 때 의료진에게 보여주면 변화 추세를 살피는 데 도움이 된다. 대한심부전학회 자료는 장기간 증상이 없는 환자의 경우 매일이 아니라 주기적으로 체중을 확인할 수도 있다고 덧붙인다.

체중과 함께 다리나 발목이 새로 붓는지, 숨이 차는 증상이 나타나거나 심해지는지도 살펴야 한다. 질병관리청과 서울아산병원 자료는 체중 증가와 부종, 호흡곤란을 심부전 악화를 시사할 수 있는 변화로 다룬다.)

체중이 빠르게 늘거나 평소와 다른 증상이 이어지면 담당 의료진에게 알리고, 본인에게 적용할 체중 변화 기준과 연락 시점을 확인하는 것이 필요하다. 이뇨제 용량이나 복용 횟수는 임의로 바꾸지 않아야 한다. 대한심부전학회 자료는 이뇨제를 과도하게 늘리면 탈수나 혈압 저하가 생길 수 있어 주치의와 상의해야 한다고 밝힌다.
